split_policy.note: No holdout material exists yet, so every test is non-blind and must be reported as internal regression, not independent blind evaluation (spec §4/§5). Reserve future clips (especially human-labelled ones) as holdout before tuning on them.

truth_policy.MACHINE_WEAK: ASR/model output — development regression only, never an independent truth
